title: Disinfection: ultraviolet light
summary: UV light inactivates pathogens without chemicals.

sections.heading: Key points
sections.body: Disinfection: ultraviolet light. UV light inactivates pathogens without chemicals.

sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: UV reactors damage pathogen DNA so organisms cannot reproduce. No chemicals are added and no residual remains, so UV usually pairs with a secondary disinfectant for distribution.

record_text:
Key points.
Disinfection: ultraviolet light. UV light inactivates pathogens without chemicals.

In depth.
UV reactors damage pathogen DNA so organisms cannot reproduce. No chemicals are added and no residual remains, so UV usually pairs with a secondary disinfectant for distribution.
